scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:source && bun run typecheck:tests && bun run typecheck:smoke
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:kb-model-smoke:aggregate
scripts.test:kb-policy: node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts tests/kb-policy.test.ts tests/kb-model-policy.test.ts tests/kb-profile-registry.test.ts tests/kb-profile-grants.test.ts
scripts.test:kb-workflows: node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts tests/kb-workflows.test.ts tests/kb-ingest.test.ts tests/kb-save-e2e.test.ts tests/kb-query-start.test.ts
scripts.test:kb-loader-policy: node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts tests/kb-loader-policy.test.ts tests/ssot-session.test.ts tests/worker-posture.test.ts tests/kb-model-policy.test.ts
scripts.test:kb-model-smoke-contract: env -u PENNY_KB_MODEL_SMOKE node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts smoke/kb-model-smoke-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:kb-model-smoke:aggregate: if test "${PENNY_KB_MODEL_SMOKE:-}" = "1"; then bun run test:kb-model-smoke; else echo 'Skipping opt-in live KB model smoke; set PENNY_KB_MODEL_SMOKE=1 to authorize it.'; fi
scripts.test:kb-model-smoke: test "${PENNY_KB_MODEL_SMOKE:-}" = "1" || { echo 'Set PENNY_KB_MODEL_SMOKE=1 to run the one predeclared live KB model cohort.' >&2; exit 1; }; node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.kb-model-smoke.config.ts
scripts.smoke:research: echo 'Smoke: set PENNY_RESEARCH_DEFAULT_MODEL and pipe a start request to dist/cli.js --execute'
